device-literals.description: Device ids and names outside the allowed places may not grow beyond tools/nx/device-literals.baseline.json (reads every tracked file: not cached, and any tracked-file change selects it in the affected gate; `lint` depends on it).

test-source.description: Every Rust file that matches config/test-source-patterns.json is declared behind #[cfg(test)]: the daemon, patchkit and device-test keys leave such files out by name.

fmt-check.description: Prettier for web files and clang-format for C (tools/nx/c-format.mjs). Not cached: prettier also opens files it never formats (.py, .rs), and nested .gitignore and .editorconfig files change its result.

options.command: node tools/nx/rust-env.mjs -- cargo fmt --check -p elektron-native-boot -p sharc-peer -p digi-wasm-core -p coldfire -p device-profile -p dt2-firmware-loader -p emmc-card -p periph -p live-audio -p machine -p patchkit -p dkupload -p sharc-rt -p plusdrive-format -p dksample -p sharc-fast-wasm -p sharc-fast-cl -p sharc-native -p sharc-rig -p sharc-gen -p sharc-stats -p bootstrap-emu -p digi-control -p digi-coupled -p dkmidi -p dkbulk -p dkui-host -p digiemu-desktop -p dkneeds -p dkrt-sdk -p dkrt-abi -p dkrt-fit -p dkrt-lifecycle -p dkrt-link -p dkrt-svc-rt -p dkrt-test-support -p dkrt-svc-fx -p dkrt-svc-rows -p dkrt-svc-bitmap -p dkrt-svc-machines -p dkrt-svc-lfo -p dkrt-svc-shortcuts -p dkrt-svc-samples -p dkrt-svc-project

rust-fmt.description: Workspace crates except dkfw, whose crate root is generated.

options.command: node tools/nx/rust-env.mjs -- cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p coldfire -p dt2-firmware-loader -p emmc-card -p dkupload -p sharc-gen -p sharc-stats -p bootstrap-emu -p dkmidi -p dkbulk -p dkui-host -p device-profile -p periph -p machine -p plusdrive-format -p dksample -p dkneeds -p dkaddrmap -p dksharc -p dkprof -- -D warnings

rust-clippy.description: cargo clippy with -D warnings on the workspace crates that have no clippy warnings. Add a crate when its warnings are fixed.
